name: Chimgan Lodge
tagline: A boutique hotel in the Chimgan mountains

seo.title: Chimgan Lodge — boutique mountain hotel 90 min from Tashkent
seo.description: Twelve rooms facing Big Chimgan, a banya, a restaurant and trails from the doorstep. Transfers from Tashkent; rooms from 1,400,000 UZS a night with breakfast.
seo.answer: Chimgan Lodge is a 12-room boutique hotel in Chimgan village, a 90-minute drive from Tashkent. Rooms start at 1,400,000 UZS a night with breakfast; check-in from 14:00, check-out by 12:00. There are transfers from Tashkent, a banya, a restaurant and mountain trails from the door.

listing.description: A website for a boutique hotel, country club or glamping site. A WebGL sunrise over the mountains, a ribbon of rooms with prices, experiences, directions and booking.

business.street: 7 Gornaya St., Chimgan village, Bostanlyk District

sections.title: A sunrise worth waking up for
sections.subtitle: Twelve rooms facing Big Chimgan, silence, a juniper banya and trails that begin at the door.

sections.label: The lodge
sections.title: A house of stone and wood, built so the mountains come first
sections.text:
We set the hotel on the slope so every room sees the peak of Big Chimgan. The stone comes from the local riverbed, the wood is elm and walnut, the textiles are handmade by craftswomen from Rishtan and Margilan.
There are no loud parties or entertainers here. There is morning coffee on the terrace, dinner by the fireplace and stars you never see in the city.

sections.label: Rooms
sections.title: Twelve rooms with a view of the peaks

items.title: The Trail room
items.text: A large bed, a floor-to-ceiling window onto the valley, a hot-stone shower.

items.title: The Peak room
items.text: A terrace facing Big Chimgan and a freestanding bath.

items.title: Family suite
items.text: Two bedrooms, a living room with a fireplace, children’s amenities on request.

items.title: Riverside chalet
items.text: A separate house by the stream with its own banya, kitchen and grill area.

items.title: Juniper banya
items.text: A Russian banya with a plunge pool fed by a mountain stream and herbal tea.

items.title: Fireside restaurant
items.text: Seasonal cooking, trout from the neighbouring farm, bread from the oven.

items.title: Trails and guides
items.text: Routes of 2 to 8 hours: waterfalls, Beldersay, the Kumbel plateau.

items.title: Skiing in winter
items.text: The Beldersay cable cars are 15 minutes away, with transfers to the lifts.

sections.label: Experiences
sections.title: What a day in the mountains feels like

items.title: Transfer
items.text: We pick you up from Tashkent or the airport by minivan: 450,000 UZS per car one way.

items.title: By car
items.text: The A-373 highway towards Gazalkent and Chimgan, 85 km. Parking at the hotel is free.

items.title: Check-in
items.text: Reception is open around the clock — even if you arrive at night, we’ll leave the lights on and hot tea waiting.

items.quote: We woke to the light on the peak and realised we hadn’t opened our phones since the night before. We’ll be back in winter.
items.author: Nigora and Said

items.quote: The riverside chalet is perfect for a family: the kids by the stream, us in the banya, dinner brought right to the house.
items.author: Irina

items.q: What are check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 12:00. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability at 50% of the nightly rate.

items.q: Is there a transfer from Tashkent?
items.a: Yes, a minivan for up to 6 people is 450,000 UZS one way, or 550,000 UZS from the airport. The drive takes about 90 minutes.
Dogs up to 15 kg are welcome in the riverside chalet and family suite, 200,000 UZS per stay. Please mention it when booking.

items.q: Is the hotel good for children?
items.a: Yes: cots and high chairs are free, there is a kids’ menu, and children under 6 without a separate bed stay free.
Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival. After that we keep the first night’s rate; over New Year a non-refundable 50% deposit applies.

items.q: What is included in the rate?
items.a: Breakfast, parking, Wi-Fi, winter transfers to the Beldersay lifts and trekking pole hire.

sections.label: Reservations
sections.title: The mountains are waiting — choose your dates
sections.text: Write or call — we’ll match you with a room, a transfer and a route for your first day.
